caso.texto:
North Services announced expansion. Clear Team offers sales-process organisation but does not know whether the expansion creates a need. Of 80 fictional eligible recipients, 12 replied: four refusals, five information requests and three meeting requests. One subject falsely says RE: our meeting.

A Chennai professional-services firm has announced a new office. Operations wants a workflow example; accounts needs billing details if a project advances. No buying timeline is confirmed and the preferred initial format is a short written note.

projeto.instrucoes: Write five emails with distinct purposes, three professional-network messages and a fictional ten-day sequence with stopping rules; calculate replies and meeting requests separately.
projeto.gabarito: Remove the false prior relationship. Reply rate is 12/80=15%; meeting requests are 3/80=3.75%, not held meetings. Remove refusals. Use distinct purposes: relevance, clarification, requested material, next-step confirmation and appropriate closure.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
